package generated

import (
	"context"
	"database/sql"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	_ "github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3"
	rhandler "github.com/viant/datly/runtime/handler"
	"github.com/viant/datly/runtime/handler/writer"
	"github.com/viant/datly/spec"
	"github.com/viant/datly/sql/dml"
	_ "github.com/viant/sqlx/metadata/product/sqlite"
	handler "github.com/viant/xdatly/handler"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func (i *OwnersInput) Init(context.Context) error {
	for _, owner := range i.Owners {
		for _, previous := range i.CurrentMembers {
			if previous.OwnerId == owner.Id {
				removed := Member{Id: previous.Id, OwnerId: previous.OwnerId}
				removed.SetRemove(true)
				owner.PreparedMembers = append(owner.PreparedMembers, &removed)
			}
		}
		owner.PreparedMembers = append(owner.PreparedMembers, owner.Members...)
	}
	return nil
}

type preparedBinder struct{ data *dml.Data }
type preparedReadFields map[string]bool

func (f preparedReadFields) Has(name string) bool { return f[name] }
func (f preparedReadFields) RootHolder() string   { return "" }
func (f preparedReadFields) DirectOutput() bool   { return true }
func (f preparedReadFields) Fields(ordinal int, path ...handler.ReadStep) (handler.FieldSet, error) {
	if ordinal != 0 || len(path) != 0 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown read row")
	}
	return f, nil
}

type preparedReads struct{}

func (preparedReads) Projection(name string) (handler.ReadProjection, error) {
	switch name {
	case "CurrentOwners":
		return preparedReadFields{"Id": true}, nil
	case "CurrentMembers":
		return preparedReadFields{"Id": true, "OwnerId": true}, nil
	}
	return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown read %s", name)
}
func (*preparedBinder) Bind(context.Context, any) error { return nil }
func (b *preparedBinder) Lookup(_ context.Context, key handler.ValueKey) (any, bool, error) {
	switch key {
	case handler.FrameworkValidatorKey:
		return b.data.FrameworkValidator(), true, nil
	case handler.DMLKey, handler.SequencerKey, handler.TransactionStarterKey:
		return b.data, true, nil
	}
	return nil, false, nil
}
func TestPreparedNativeReplacement(t *testing.T) {
	type useCase struct {
		description string
		reject      bool
		expectedID  int
	}
	for _, tc := range []useCase{{"replace", false, 2}, {"rollback", true, 1}} {
		t.Run(tc.description, func(t *testing.T) {
			db, err := sql.Open("sqlite3", ":memory:")
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			defer db.Close()
			db.SetMaxOpenConns(1)
			for _, q := range []string{"CREATE TABLE owners(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY)", "CREATE TABLE members(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,owner_id INTEGER NOT NULL)", "INSERT INTO owners VALUES(1),(9)", "INSERT INTO members VALUES(1,1),(9,9)"} {
				if _, err = db.Exec(q); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
			}
			if tc.reject {
				if _, err = db.Exec("CREATE TRIGGER reject_insert BEFORE INSERT ON members WHEN NEW.id=2 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'rejected insertion'); END"); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
			}
			original := &Owner{Id: 1, Members: []*Member{{Id: 2, OwnerId: 1, Has: &MemberHas{Id: true, OwnerId: true}}}}
			owner := new(Owner)
			if err = db.QueryRow("SELECT id FROM owners WHERE id=1").Scan(&owner.Id); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			input := &OwnersInput{Owners: []*Owner{original}, CurrentOwners: []*Owner{owner}}
			rows, err := db.Query("SELECT id,owner_id FROM members WHERE owner_id=1")
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			for rows.Next() {
				row := new(Member)
				if err = rows.Scan(&row.Id, &row.OwnerId); err != nil {
					t.Fatal(err)
				}
				input.CurrentMembers = append(input.CurrentMembers, row)
			}
			rows.Close()
			component := &spec.Component{Key: spec.Key{Scope: reflect.TypeFor[Owner]().PkgPath()}, Settings: &spec.Settings{Mutation: "patch"}, RootView: &spec.View{Name: "o", Auxiliary: true, Source: &spec.ViewSource{Table: "owners"}}}
			native, err := writer.New(component, reflect.TypeFor[OwnersInput](), reflect.TypeFor[OwnersOutput](), "patch")
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			ctx := handler.WithReadMetadata(context.Background(), preparedReads{})
			data := dml.NewData(db)
			if err = data.BeginInvocation(); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			snapshot, err := native.CaptureInput(ctx, input)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if err = input.Init(ctx); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			_, err = native.Execute(ctx, rhandler.Invocation{Input: input, Snapshot: snapshot, Binder: &preparedBinder{data: data}})
			completeErr := data.Complete(ctx, err)
			if err == nil {
				err = completeErr
			}
			if (err != nil) != tc.reject {
				t.Fatalf("unexpected result: %v", err)
			}
			var id int
			if err = db.QueryRow("SELECT id FROM members WHERE owner_id=1").Scan(&id); err != nil || id != tc.expectedID {
				t.Fatalf("id=%d err=%v", id, err)
			}
			if err = db.QueryRow("SELECT id FROM members WHERE owner_id=9").Scan(&id); err != nil || id != 9 {
				t.Fatalf("sibling changed: %d %v", id, err)
			}
			if input.Owners[0] != original || original.Members[0].Id != 2 {
				t.Fatal("public graph changed")
			}
			wire, err := json.Marshal(original)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if strings.Contains(string(wire), "PreparedMembers") || strings.Contains(string(wire), "Remove") {
				t.Fatalf("internal write state exposed: %s", wire)
			}
		})
	}
}
